title: The Cathedral of Light
summary: An ancient block-built forest at dawn with thick volumetric sun shafts through mist.
description: An ancient block-built forest in early morning, where low sunlight pours through gaps in the canopy as volumetric shafts into drifting mist. Pixel art rendered into a 270 px tall HDR buffer with nearest-neighbour upscaling, procedural 16x16 block textures and shadow-mapped light shafts. Interactive build: drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan, with sliders that relight the forest live. One self-contained HTML file with three.js. Built by Qwen 4 Max Preview in DeepSeek Harness from the same prompt as the other entries in this comparison.
